projectDescription: A mobile-first single-page web app for planning rail and bus trips across the City Metro transit network, featuring real-time itineraries, service alerts, an interactive map, and OAuth 2.0 / OIDC sign-in with transit accounts.
keyFeatures: Hash-router SPA with eight views: Plan, Results, Itinerary, Transit, Map, Alerts, Account, Sign In
OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE flow against an Authentik-compatible provider (no client secret)
OpenID Connect discovery — provider endpoints fetched from /.well-known/openid-configuration
Timetable simulation engine that enumerates paths, schedules departures, and tags trips (Fastest, Fewest transfers, Least walking)
Filterable service alerts by line or stop
Interactive schematic map with toggleable line overlays
Mobile-first responsive design with bottom nav on mobile and top nav on desktop
Full accessibility: skip link, ARIA live regions, focus trapping in drawer, reduced-motion support
Demo-data mode: plug-and-play without a live backend; swap in real data via trip-service.js
publicApiSurface: AUTH config (issuer, clientId, redirectUri, postLogoutRedirectUri, scopes) in js/config.js
LINKS config (website, transitPolice, support, accountSettings) in js/config.js
beginLogin(returnTo, env?) → Promise<string> — builds the authorization URL
startLogin(returnTo, env?) — redirects the browser to the provider
completeLogin(search, env?) → Promise<{ returnTo, session }> — exchanges the code for tokens
getSession(env?) → Session | null — reads the active session from sessionStorage
signOutEverywhere(env?) → Promise<string | null> — ends the provider session too
setNotice(code, message, env?) / takeNotice(env?) — one-time cross-page notice
missingConfig(env?) → string[] — returns missing required config field names
mountShell(root) — initialises the persistent app frame
updateShell(path) — highlights the active nav item
notifyAuthChange() — dispatches 'cm-auth' event to refresh header/drawer
